title: Storage fix: users no longer vanish and new users persist (cloud sync hardened)
notes: Fixed: shared cloud storage could wipe every device's local data — when a collection's Supabase row came back EMPTY it was adopted as authoritative and overwrote the device's real local users on load (this is why current users disappeared)

Fixed: new users/records created while not signed in were silently dropped by the cloud write and then removed on the next load — sync errors are no longer swallowed and failed pushes no longer cascade into data loss
Fixed: an empty array from a single device can no longer upsert over the shared mirror for the whole community (empty states stay local-only)
Safe upgrade: any device still holding real users re-uploads them automatically on next load
